title: situation.missouri_provisional_government.title
railroad: the state convention vacates the offices and installs a provisional government on 30 or 31 July; a convention is not modelled, so its act comes on its date once the call is made

gate.none: a convention installs a provisional government; the governor's rival government continues in the field

citations.at: the convention journal, July session (per the numbers note: the July journal itself not found)
